Afar are Muslim; Aussa was their notable sultanate. Menelik's forces defeated Sultan Muhammad Hanfare in 1896, making Aussa tributary (detail from leads). Ethiopian court stayed Orthodox Christian (state religion to 1974), writing Ge'ez/Amharic.
